name: Visual Crossing Weather
tagline: Timeline weather API with historical data and forecasts in one call
description: Timeline weather API combining historical observations and forecasts in one call. API-key auth; free tier includes 1000 records/day.

auth.details: Researching authentication method from official docs.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 1000 records/day free (no credit card); record = one day of weather data for a location

rate_limits: Primary limit is daily record quota (Free: 1000 records/day); higher tiers raise caps. Fixed concurrent/RPM limits are plan-dependent and not always published as a single RPM figure

example.response_snippet: {"queryCost":1,"latitude":51.5064,"longitude":-0.12721,"resolvedAddress":"London, England, United Kingdom","address":"London,UK","timezone":"Europe/London","days":[{"datetime":"2026-03-08","tempmax":12.1,"tempmin":5.2,"temp":8.4,"conditions":"Partially cloudy","description":"Partly cloudy throughout the day."}]}

use_cases: get current weather for a city
